verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own quickstart docs say SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA and PCI-DSS can all be managed in one platform, which matches the story exactly. The support is a single overview-level claim repeated across pages, with no framework-specific documentation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on HIPAA and PCI DSS control mappings or workflows, cross-framework control reuse details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO — HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS — are supported from the same platform so new customer requirements don't mean a new tool

citations.quote: One platform, multiple frameworks: Manage SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and others in one place.
meet and maintain compliance across standards like SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and more
